name: project_understanding
description: Answers project-level questions from the knowledge graph: 'what calls X', 'what depends on Y', 'what changed since Z'. Backed by the file index (000041) and persisted symbols. Returns graph slices, never raw file dumps.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Symbol, path, or dependency question, e.g. 'callers of AuthService.login'.

inputs.name: since_commit
inputs.description: Restrict to changes after a git ref.

side_effects: Reads the persisted knowledge graph (memory module); updates are performed by the file_indexing contract

error_codes.message: No knowledge graph exists for the project root.
error_codes.recovery: Run AIOS-CONTRACT-000041 to build the index; return an empty answer meanwhile.

error_codes.message: Graph older than the latest file change.
error_codes.recovery: Flag staleness; suggest re-indexing; return the best available slice with a staleness marker.

examples: query='callers of AuthService.login' -> answer.edges of kind 'calls' terminating at that node.
